title: Create SQLite schema and populate event database
description: Design and implement SQLite schema for events table. Index by date for efficient querying. Store in data/events.db.

title: Build Wikipedia scraper for WWI events
description: Scrape Wikipedia categories for WWI events by year (1914-1918). Extract event titles, dates, summaries, and citations.

title: Parse dates and extract citations from Wikipedia articles
description: For each Wikipedia article, extract specific dates mentioned, parse them into structured format, and capture Wikipedia citations as source metadata.

title: Tag multi-day events (battles, conferences)
description: Identify events that span multiple days (e.g., Battle of the Somme, Paris Peace Conference). Add start_date, end_date, and parent_event fields to the schema.

title: Validate event index for June-August 1914
description: Spot-check the event index for the critical period around the war's start. Verify dates, ensure major events are captured (assassination, declarations of war, mobilizations).
